comments.body: Here's a related PR for fcrepo-camel: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel/pull/94
Former user's PR for fcrepo-camel-toolbox: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/55

Owners/Maintainers for existing:

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/migration-utils – Michael Durbin and me? or Former user or Jared Whiklo

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer – Andrew Woods or Former user or A. Soroka? (Going from most commits – https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer/graphs/contributors)

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus – Andrew Woods or Unknown or Mohamed Mohideen Abdul Rasheed? (Going from most commits – https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/graphs/contributors)

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-transform – Needs a README!

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-audit – Andrew Woods or Michael Durbin or A. Soroka or Unknown? Going from most commits --https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-audit/graphs/contributors)
I thought we were going to kill fcrepo-message-consumer?
I don't think fcrepo-audit is real anymore. Hasn't it been superseded by the work on the larger audit platform?
fcrepo-audit is definitely a real project. That is what implements the internal audit record (storing audit records in the repository under a certain node).
AFAIK, with fcrepo-message-consumer we're waiting on the completion of https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1519 before killing it off.
Okay, in that case I am not a good person to put for fcrepo-audit. I was totally uninvolved with that whole effort.
Former user's PR to fcrepo-camel-toolbox has been merged with master via https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/commit/2d0ae5feadd8cd43f88ea4eb53f5df706e29a7b8
Related PR for migration-utils: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/migration-utils/pull/38
I merged the PR for migration-utils.
Merged https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel/pull/94

So it looks like we just need to sort out:

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-transform
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-audit

and we're done? Andrew Woods should we see if we can sort this out on Thursday's call?
fcrepo4-vagrant: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo4-vagrant/pull/24 – merged

To Nick Ruest's list above, I would add two additional projects:

https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-audit-ontology
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-indexing-ontology
fcrepo-webapp-plus: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/26
fcrepo-transform: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-transform/pull/2
Nick Ruest's PR for fcrepo-transform has been merged to master via https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-transform/commit/22ced59400a402c041b7e0d11a35ec762dc989ac
This is still a fcrepo4-labs project, but it is somewhat related: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-karaf/pull/13
